listings.Job Description: The Media Partnerships Intern will work in the media partnerships team of the media and marketing services department. Acting as a key team-wide coordinator supporting a wide range of administrative, operational, and client management activities, working in a global broadcast environment delivering Asia’s biggest and most celebrated football competitions and tournaments.
listings.Job Requirements: Prior experience or degree in sponsorship/sports marketing is a distinct advantage; University degree; Interest and knowledge in football is an advantage; Passion for football/sports, media, entertainment and/or broadcast; Ability to manage multiple tasks at a time; Emphasis on timelines and delivery of projects under pressure; Knowledge of design tools like Photoshop, Illustrator, etc. is a distinct advantage; Excellent verbal and written communications skills in English (additional fluency in other languages within AFC region a distinct advantage – particularly Arabic); Highly proficient in Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and Outlook).
